concept_options.title: What If Everyone Got Free Money Every Month?
concept_options.hook: Your phone buzzes. So does everyone else's. The same amount, for all of you, every month.
concept_options.visual_approach: You staring at your phone as a coin pops out, the street doing the same; tag NO STRINGS
concept_options.why_this_works: Plain promise; the thumbnail carries the condition

concept_options.title: Would Anyone Still Work If Money Was Free?
concept_options.hook: The money arrives on a Monday. Do you go in?
concept_options.visual_approach: You strolling out of the office, the boss calling after you; tag I QUIT?
concept_options.why_this_works: The sharpest single question the trials answer

concept_options.title: What If Nobody Had to Work to Eat?
concept_options.hook: The alarm goes off, and for the first time you do not have to obey it.
concept_options.visual_approach: You with feet on the table and a full plate, alarm clock tossed; tag ALARM OFF

selected_concept.rationale: Agent's recommendation; the owner picks at G1. The plainest wording of the owner's question; the thumbnail adds 'no strings'.

stages.approach: Packaging: three title and thumbnail pairs, the premise, the runtime decision
research.md, claims.md and script.md; omni qc story_script (claims) must pass
Arthur, one paid take per line, quoted and approved first; needs the engine
Code-drawn scenes timed to cue words; needs the engine
Owner notes applied; loudness, clicks and similarity checks
The owner watches at 1x with cold viewers
publish.md and upload.yaml; private upload only when the owner asks
